verdict.rationale: Moss is a cloud-backed semantic search service that stores customer documents, so a no-training guarantee or opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no policy, setting, or contractual statement about whether customer data is used to train AI models. On-device embedding and local queries are adjacent architecture features, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
